hookText: POV: You caught the manor's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: Aye, I was just tiptoeing through the hallways, trying not to make a sound. The shadows stretched long, and I almost tripped on my own feet. The manor's new maid, fresh and new as the linen in the kitchen, she's quite a sight to see.
caption:
Caught you in the shadows, sweet maid. What secrets do you keep? 🕯️
